description: Structured Home Field image-generation queue for agent/factory runs. Each item is a durable, machine-readable contract; prompt text and workflow docs remain the detailed human source.

items.displayTitle: Thalla Home Field chibi Stage 1 proof
items.minimalLauncherPrompt: In /Users/microwavedev/workspace/microwave-hub/mushroom-master, run `npm run game:home-field:generation-queue -- --id=thalla-stage1-chibi-proof` and follow the printed agent instructions exactly.

promptPolicy.blockedPromptAction: Do not give minimalLauncherPrompt to the user as a new production-ready run prompt while this queue item or method gate is blocked. First include a concrete allowed unblock input in the prompt: an explicit paid fallback env file containing OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY plus HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1, a supplied complete 8x4 local state-sheet source PNG outside docs/reference via HOME_FIELD_CHIBI_LOCAL_IMAGE_INPUTS, supplied local proof source PNGs outside docs/reference, or a different queue-approved reference-capable generation/editing method.
promptPolicy.blockedShortResponse: Blocked: do not start another production run from the minimal launcher until an allowed non-built-in path, supplied proof source PNGs, or explicit paid fallback env file is provided.

agentInstructions: Run this queue item as: Thalla Home Field chibi Stage 1 proof.

Do not give the minimalLauncherPrompt back to the user as a new production-ready run prompt while this item or its method gate is blocked; only provide a new-run prompt if it includes one concrete allowed unblock input from promptPolicy.
Run npm run game:home-field:chibi-proof-context, npm run game:home-field:next-chibi-proof, and preflight before archive/imagegen.
Do not infer `.env` or neighboring repo env files; paid API fallback requires the launcher/user to provide --env-file=<explicit-env-file>.
Prefer built-in/imagegen skill only when HOME_FIELD_BUILTIN_IMAGEGEN_CAN_SAVE=1 and HOME_FIELD_BUILTIN_IMAGEGEN_CAN_USE_REFERENCES=1 are confirmed in the same agent context that will run imagegen.

For the built-in path, load each referenceInputs PNG with view_image as the current imagegen skill's same-context input-staging step, then use built-in image_gen with those visible images explicitly named as references; passive viewing without the image_gen call is not enough.

Method gate: the queue-backed built-in same-context reference-staging path is exhausted after rollout codex-019f1eb1-1027-7752-95cf-d4f37cb0041c; do not run it again without a different generation method, source-input path, or explicit user-approved fallback.

Use paid API fallback only if built-in/imagegen is unavailable and the explicit env file contains OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY plus HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1; plain OPENAI_API_KEY is ignored.
Attach every referenceInputs PNG as actual image inputs to imagegen; passive viewing, listing paths, or using view_image without the following same-context image_gen reference call is not enough.

If the launcher supplies HOME_FIELD_CHIBI_LOCAL_IMAGE_INPUTS with exactly one complete 8x4 local state-sheet PNG outside docs/reference, treat that path as the concrete unblock input: preflight and archive with the same env, run npm run game:home-field:stage-chibi-local-source, then continue at reference-proxy verification, state-sheet verification, palette audit, split, frame verify, candidate production, candidate validation, evidence, preview, and verdict. Do not run reference imagegen or the exhausted built-in reference-staging path for this local-source run.

For generated grouped sheets, continue past the reference gate only if the grouped 8x4 state sheet can attach .agent/home-field-workspace/reference/thalla_chibi_turnaround.reference.png as an actual image input; for supplied complete local state-sheet source mode, continue only after stage-chibi-local-source derives that reference proxy and the proxy/state-sheet verifier plus palette audits pass.
Stop before archive/imagegen if preflight, reference verifier, palette audit, visual gate, or method gate fails.
Do not overwrite app-facing PNGs during candidate proof; write only to .agent/home-field-workspace/candidates/chibi-active-roster/latest until approved.

blockedRunEvidence.reason: The agent used mushroom-master/.env for --env-file; preflight correctly failed because the required imagegen fallback environment was missing. Future API fallback runners must receive an explicit env file path with OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY and HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1 instead of guessing. Plain OPENAI_API_KEY must not count.

builtInImagegen.referenceStaging: Load all 3 referenceInputs PNGs with view_image as the current imagegen skill's same-context input-staging step before imagegen.
builtInImagegen.generationCall: Call built-in image_gen in that same context and explicitly name the visible referenceInputs images as references.
builtInImagegen.afterRender: Save each generated PNG directly to the required output path, or claim a discoverable built-in output with npm run game:home-field:claim-imagegen-output -- --since=<render-start-iso> --dest=<documented-path> --verify=<reference|state-sheet>.
builtInImagegen.notEnough: Passive viewing, listing paths, or mentioning reference paths in prompt text is not enough unless the following same-context built-in image_gen call uses those visible images as references.

methodGate.reason: The queue-backed built-in path was tried with same-context view_image staging, a same-context built-in image_gen reference call, and save/claim handoff. It still failed the reference verifier with 1448x1086 oversized turnaround figures and failed palette audit with 91 significant exact colors, so this built-in method is exhausted for unchanged Thalla proof runs.
methodGate.allowedPath: Do not run the built-in same-context staging path again. Continue only with a different reference-capable generation/editing method, supplied local proof source PNGs outside docs/reference, or explicit user-approved fallback.
methodGate.stopIf: Stop before archive/imagegen if no different method/source-input path is available; the exhausted built-in staging path must not be retried.

referenceInputs.role: primary positive compact grouped-sheet proportions and charm; fix palette bloat, ornament, and sticker softness
positive Thalla face, cap, and robe appeal only; simplify heavily
target scale, outline weight, and scene-scale simplicity only; do not copy symbols, costumes, or composition

referenceSheet.method: built-in/imagegen skill with all referenceInputs attached or loaded as same-context visible image inputs when save+reference binding is confirmed; otherwise paid image_gen.py edit fallback through chibi-reference-api-proof only after HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1 and OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY are set
referenceSheet.paletteBudget: 12-18 artist-visible colors; fewer than 20 total design colors excluding transparency and #ff00ff
referenceSheet.mustShow: tiny down, up, left, and right source-sprite views inside invisible 96x96 boxes with at least 70% empty #ff00ff space

stateSheet.method: one coherent grouped 8x4 state sheet generated through a reference-capable image path, or one supplied complete 8x4 local state-sheet source staged through game:home-field:stage-chibi-local-source
stateSheet.layout: 8 columns x 4 rows; rows down, up, left, right; 2 idle plus 6 walk frames per row
stateSheet.motionRule: idle bob and walk poses must exist in the grouped sheet itself; do not synthesize motion after split

stopRules: Stop before archive/imagegen if preflight fails.
Stop if paid API fallback is attempted without an explicit env file containing OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY and HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1.
Stop if the run relies on plain OPENAI_API_KEY for image generation; it is intentionally ignored.
Stop if the active imagegen path can only use prompt text for the reference or state sheet.
Stop if the run would reuse the exhausted built-in same-context reference-staging path without a different generation method or source-input path.
For a supplied complete 8x4 local state-sheet source, stop if game:home-field:stage-chibi-local-source fails; do not fall back to imagegen or stale .agent files.
Stop and report the blocker instead of giving a new production-ready launcher prompt when the queue item remains blocked and no concrete allowed unblock input is provided.
Stop if the reference sheet fails verifier, palette audit, or visual gate.
Stop if the grouped state sheet cannot attach the approved reference PNG as an actual image input.
Do not overwrite app-facing PNGs during candidate proof.
finalResponseMustReport: whether archive, imagegen, state sheet, split frames, candidate, evidence, preview, and record verdict ran
reference, state-sheet, and candidate palette audit verdicts when those stages run
for local state-sheet source runs, the supplied source path, sha256, and statement that reference imagegen was skipped and a deterministic reference proxy was derived
that no app-facing PNG was overwritten
